notes: Checklist evidence: real photo/PDF upload for violation records via Supabase Storage (phf-checklist-evidence bucket). Replaces the placeholder '+ Minh chung' button/toast in quick, multi-day and detail entry with real camera/library/desktop file pickers, preview, remove, retry and per-file upload status. Evidence is uploaded as an unlinked draft, then attached to the real violation via phf_attach_checklist_evidence after saveChecklistViolations persists it (server resolves violation id from requestId, never trusts a client-supplied id). has_evidence is now server-authoritative. SQL not yet applied to Production - see scripts/PHF_CHECKLIST_EVIDENCE_1.41.0.sql.
